label: Monday night: where the matchup is
note: With garbage time removed the Bills are still 25th. Wentz was sacked on 9.7% of dropbacks last season, the 5th-highest rate among 43 QBs.

explainer.title: Nobody scores every play. Every play still counts.
explainer.text: Each snap moves a drive closer to points or further away. 1st-and-10 at your own 25 is worth about 1.1 points on average; at the opponent's 25, about 4.2. A pass that gets you from one to the other is worth the difference. Here's what 1st-and-10 is worth by field position.
